cards.summary: SubSim now has local project state, evaluation contract, ship targets, campaign plan, and reports for the bounded ReadyPlayer1 evaluation loop. Campaign 001 is sonar contact readability under clutter, anchored by ReadyPlayer1 before metrics for clutter_false_positive.
cards.title: SubSim x ReadyPlayer1 preflight documented and Campaign 001 selected

cards.body_excerpt: The fire_control block includes fire_control_ready, fire_control_solution_state, fire_control_solution_quality, weapon_ready, valid_fire_opportunity, hold reason, target id, solution timing, and active_torpedo_count. This is producer/adapter visibility only; torpedo physics and firing timing were not changed.
cards.summary: SubSim exposes fire-control readiness and solution-state data through build_observation and sonar-console frames for ReadyPlayer1 Campaign 005A.
cards.title: SubSim fire_control observation contract v1

cards.body_excerpt: The next recommended slice is to normalize SubSim live FireControl solution state into sonar replay/live observations so ReadyPlayer1 can distinguish solution_start, ready, fired, miss, and reacquisition feedback without approximating entirely from policy memory.
cards.summary: Campaign 004A was a ReadyPlayer1 policy/evaluator improvement and did not change SubSim torpedo physics, damage, range, sonar producer behavior, or scenario expectations. SubSim remains the protected producer surface for future fire-control state normalization.
cards.title: Campaign 004A leaves SubSim fire-control physics unchanged

cards.body_excerpt: The fixture export commands were rerun successfully for 78 cases/fixtures after fixed splits were rebuilt with seed 1337. Runtime policy decisions should still use contact evidence, confidence, lifecycle, ambiguity, and binding quality rather than fixture labels as direct truth.
cards.summary: SubSim hydrophone artifacts under data/hydrophone/fixtures and data/hydrophone/manifests/splits are the fixed inputs for ReadyPlayer1 Campaign 003 acoustic clutter-binding evaluation. Promotion scoring defaults to heldout_source_eval and excludes synthetic cases unless explicitly requested.
cards.title: Hydrophone fixtures feed ReadyPlayer1 acoustic clutter scoring

cards.body_excerpt: The fixed eval slice writes data/hydrophone/manifests/splits/{train,validation,heldout_source_eval}.jsonl plus split_summary.json, updates classifier training to use those manifests with separate validation and heldout-source metrics, and exports SubSim/ReadyPlayer1 acoustic fixture JSONL under data/hydrophone/fixtures. Synthetic fixtures remain excluded by default and require explicit include flags.
cards.summary: SubSim hydrophone now has deterministic group-safe fixed splits and real-only gameplay/eval fixture exports.
cards.title: Hydrophone fixed eval and acoustic fixtures

cards.body_excerpt: The expanded slice samples ShipsEar, Watkins, NOAA fish exemplars, Zenodo pacama catfish WAVs, NOAA environmental exemplars, and MBARI cached ambient clips into data/hydrophone. Clip manifests carry group_id for grouped evaluation, datasets carry redistribution/commercial-use/license review fields, classifier defaults to real-only and writes grouped split metadata with reliability warnings.
cards.summary: SubSim hydrophone corpus now includes grouped real-class manifests with fish and ambient expansion plus conservative license metadata.
cards.title: Hydrophone corpus expansion v2

cards.body_excerpt: SubSim PerceptionEngine now computes lifecycle_state after ambiguity flags and contact_quality. Weak passive-only clutter reaches rejected, active ping or strong evidence reaches confirmed, and older confidence/clutter rejection behavior from Campaign 001 is preserved.
cards.summary: Campaign 002A extended the SubSim sonar-console PerceivedTrack contract with lifecycle_state and emits possible/suspect/tracking/confirmed/rejected/lost from perception. This is a producer-side readability signal, not a confidence threshold change.
cards.title: SubSim sonar tracks expose explicit lifecycle state

cards.body_excerpt: The slice supports dry-run dataset manifests, small real-sample fetch/copy, normalization to 16 kHz mono WAV, baseline feature extraction, stable source-path grouped RandomForest reporting, and synthetic wave generation with explicit synthetic-not-real-submarine disclaimers.
cards.summary: SubSim now has a bounded hydrophone corpus pipeline under data/hydrophone and scripts/hydrophone.
cards.title: Bounded hydrophone pipeline

cards.body_excerpt: Campaign 001 implemented weak passive-only confirmation in subsim/testing/sonar_console/perception.py. Weak passive-only contacts progress through possible_contact and suspect_contact, then emit a one-frame clutter_rejected diagnostic with clutter/unconfirmed_contact flags if they fail sustained evidence for three updates. Strengthening contacts and active-ping-confirmed contacts remain actionable. Validation: SubSim full suite 51 passed; ReadyPlayer1 after suite reduced clutter_false_positive false-positive rate from 0.5 to 0.2857142857142857.
cards.summary: SubSim sonar-console now dampens displayed confidence/quality for weak passive-only contacts and rejects persistent unconfirmed weak contacts as clutter before dropping them from policy observations.
cards.title: Campaign 001 sonar clutter readability producer behavior

cards.body_excerpt: Updated ContextStrip/Main scene and main.gd layout wiring for visible on-screen Ping/Fire controls and larger touch targets. Added simplified torpedo state in godot engine_port (ammo, cooldown, active torpedoes, heading-based launch, movement/expiry/hit removal) with status surfaced to UI and optional torpedo marker rendering. Added regression checks in tests/test_godot_mobile_controls.py and validated via Godot headless load, pytest, and Android debug export.
cards.summary: Subsim Godot mobile control surfaces were made discoverable and tappable with a larger bottom strip, explicit Ping button, and Fire behavior that launches a bounded torpedo gameplay model instead of SFX-only. Heading and attitude dial wiring were preserved.
cards.title: Godot mobile controls now include explicit Ping and gameplay-effective Fire
